title: Polars backend
label: Polars backend
checked: PolarsTable against the Table contract: joins, grouping and group order, summarise .groups, factors, list-columns, type round trips, strict mode, and DataFrame fallback for closures and rowwise operations.
description: Each test runs a PolarsTable operation and compares it with the DataFrame result or a fixed expectation.
